checklist.assertion: Pinned build, explicit paths, process and doctor; activation/editability checked separately.
Correct identity and units; malformed requests rejected; JSON results and legacy compatibility retained.
Operation state, ID/input collision, write serialization, timeout, late completion and no automatic mutation replay.
Inspect actual before/after objects and preserve unrelated content.
Save convergence and explicitly scoped reopen; distinguish same-session from cold startup.
Native output and independent media/browser/geometry validation; absence of overwrite.
Retain failures, restore previous user project or verified model parameters; no mouse input.
